problemModel.currentFailure: Opaque 1672x941 panoramas are placed as adjacent world tiles; a 820x1919 portrait mist is stretched to a narrow strip and drawn at alpha 0.08, so the join remains a recognizable vertical cut.
problemModel.playerPerception: The eye reads two unrelated screenshots because the horizon, building silhouettes, light direction, and water reflections do not cross the boundary as one scene.

design.principle: The join is its own authored raster scene, not a CSS effect and not a generic translucent cover.

transitionFamilies.visualBridge: shared awning and lantern rhythm continuing into a busier stall lane
one roof ridge handing off to a higher tiled bridge
one pier, mast and reflection line turning into the next water court
covered alley rising into a tiled roof bridge
floating stall pier turning into a lantern market edge

assetRecipe.edgeTreatment: opaque center with raster feather masks at both edges, color-matched to the outgoing and incoming plates

runtime.worldRule: Keep the existing deterministic district scheduler; derive a bridge key from seed, previous district, next district, and visit index.
runtime.placement: Render base panoramas behind the bridge plate; render bridge plate at depth -19; keep eaves/reflections in front at depth -10.
runtime.pooling: Pool bridge images with the same bounded retention policy as panorama images; never allocate one image per traveled meter.
runtime.fallback: If a bridge texture is not ready, keep the opaque base plates and defer the bridge reveal; never expose CSS or a transparent canvas gap.

implementationOrder: Generate and alpha-verify the bridge raster set; inspect composited light/dark/saturated backgrounds.
Add deterministic transition descriptors and bridge asset paths.
Replace the generic mist join with bridge plates and foreground occluders.
Add unit tests for pair coverage, deterministic keys, bounded pooling, and screen coverage.
Run natural Playwright captures at same-district and district-change joins in grounded and airborne states on 844x390 and 1180x720.
Rebuild the alias and rerun the default startup -> core loop -> terminal -> replay journey.

conceptEvidence.note: 参考原图画风的视觉方向稿：低饱和冷蓝雾夜、深色剪影、少量暖色灯笼；中心用屋檐、灯笼线和连续水面倒影承担连接，不是最终运行时切片。

nonGoals: changing player physics, collision, economy, persistence, or platform adapters
creating unique unbounded textures during play
acceptanceChecks: No recognizable hard vertical boundary at a bridge center in runtime captures.
Bridge plate and both neighboring panoramas share palette, horizon height, and light direction.
Same seed/world coordinates produce the same bridge key and layout.
Retained bridge image count stays within the renderer cap.
All existing tests plus targeted natural journey pass with no console/page errors.
